patch_description: The current EVOLVE-BLOCK (using a/b/c shared params) underperformed (0.40) relative to the earlier seed structure (0.42) that used parity-broken RY encoding, a forward/backward CNOT sandwich, a shared CRZ ring entangler, and a final shared RY readout with 6 distinct parameters. I restore that stronger structural pattern, but additionally merge the two separate RZ phase parameters (rz_a, rz_b) into a single shared "rz_ab" parameter to free up parameter budget. This lets me append the recommended concluding global RZ("rz_out") layer after the final RY readout — giving an extra adjustable phase "twist" right before measurement to sharpen class separation — while keeping the total distinct parameter count at 6, matching the best-performing prior seed's economy. This should combine the higher validation/worst-group margins of the proven structure with the sharper decision boundary from the extra readout phase, without increasing parameter cost.
